answer.justification: The output and logit changes are large: median first divergence 1, edit distance 0.777, KL 0.454, top-1 agreement 0.865. These look like system-prompted values on the surface, but the activations do not match. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.036, below the fine-tuned range (0.086-0.092) and far below system-prompted (0.113-0.133). The layer-2 spike is 0.1, nowhere near the 31.7-64 expected for a system prompt. Onset layer 2 and effective rank 3.82 do not match the system-prompted pattern either (onset 7-8, rank about 2.7). The growth through the layers (0.036 to 0.554) and direction consistency of 0.608 fit a low-rank fine-tune, probably a stronger one than those the document describes. The behavior shifts support this: 9 refusals added, disclaimers up from 7.8% to 26.6%, and very short replies up from 1.6% to 28.1%. Quantized is ruled out by the large KL, the low agreement and the growing activation difference. Confidence is moderate because several values fall outside the documented fine-tuned ranges.
